lead_headline: Restaurant tracker silent for second straight day — zero new leads detected as system idles ahead of weekend, liquor board remains frozen

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — second consecutive idle day extends weekly drought. Active pipeline steady at 347 leads (177 openings, 170 closures).

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today — six-day filing freeze now unbroken through full work week, matching late-summer voids for longest recorded drought. No status changes, no removals. 1 application this week represents 86% collapse from prior week's 7-app baseline as state liquor authority processing falls to near-complete standstill. Six-day blackout ties historical record as October filing activity evaporates.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions today pushes BusinessDen citation drought to 22 consecutive days — all-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources since August 5. Past 30-day window holds at 21 mentions as no new late-July data aged out overnight. 22-day void extends beyond all prior gaps in tracking history as October media blackout deepens with no pickup activity on horizon.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) — first zero-zero day in two weeks holds MTD at +31 (+1.2/day), 90-day net at +88. Past 7 days: +28 net (43 new, 15 canceled) vs. prior week's +31 — modest pullback as mid-week activity vanishes following strong Sunday-Monday opens. Two-week pattern shows late-week surges consistently offsetting mid-week lulls: Week 1 closed at +31, Week 2 tracking +28 as weekend acquisition strength counterbalances weekday flats. October maintains recovery momentum as YTD baseline (+248, +0.9/day) confirms structural stability beneath daily noise.
